name: Student Profile to Counselor Email - Improved
description: Complete workflow: webhook → profile parse → AI counselor + university recommendations → format email → send

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $json.studentData;

function toLine(name, val) {
  if (val === undefined || val === null) return "";
  if (Array.isArray(val)) return `${name}: ${val.join(", ")}`;
  return `${name}: ${val}`;
}

const profileBlock = [
  toLine("Name", data.personalInfo.name),
  toLine("Email", data.personalInfo.email),
  toLine("Phone", data.personalInfo.phone),
  toLine("LinkedIn", data.personalInfo.linkedin),
  toLine("Age", data.academics.age),
  toLine("Education Level", data.academics.educationLevel),
  toLine("Grading System", data.academics.gradingSystem),
  toLine("Academic Score", data.academics.academicScore),
  toLine("Standardized Test", data.academics.standardizedTest),
  toLine("Test Score", data.academics.testScore),
  toLine("Target Countries", data.preferences.targetCountries),
  toLine("Study Level", data.preferences.studyLevel),
  toLine("Budget Range (USD)", `${data.preferences.budgetMin} - ${data.preferences.budgetMax}`),
  toLine("Scholarship Interest", data.preferences.scholarshipInterest ? "Yes" : "No"),
  toLine("Subjects", data.preferences.subjects),
  toLine("Extracurriculars", data.preferences.extracurriculars),
  toLine("Career Goals", data.preferences.careerGoals)
].filter(Boolean).join("\n");

const prompt = `You are a university admissions counselor with 20 years experience.
Given the STUDENT PROFILE, produce two outputs:

1) COUNSELOR_MESSAGE:
- Tone: warm, encouraging, practical, 3-4 short paragraphs
- Include: academics positioning, country/program fit, application strategy (deadlines, docs, scholarships), next steps
- Keep under 180 words

2) RECOMMENDATIONS_JSON:
- JSON only, with keys: safe, target, dream (each an array of universities)
- Each university object MUST have: name, city, country, score (0-100), acceptance_rate (0-100), est_tuition_usd, program_fit (1 sentence), rationale (1 sentence), notes (optional)
- Split across countries as relevant; ensure budget fit when possible
- Score interprets overall fit (academics, budget, program, goals)
- Balance list sizes: safe (3-4), target (3-4), dream (3)

STUDENT PROFILE:
${profileBlock}

Return format:
<<<COUNSELOR_MESSAGE_START>>>
[message]
<<<COUNSELOR_MESSAGE_END>>>
<<<RECOMMENDATIONS_JSON_START>>>
{...valid JSON...}
<<<RECOMMENDATIONS_JSON_END>>>

STRICT OUTPUT RULES:
- Do not add any text outside the markers.
- The JSON must be strictly valid (UTF-8, double quotes, no trailing commas).
- Keys: safe, target, dream. Each is an array of 3–4 objects with: name, city, country, score, acceptance_rate, est_tuition_usd, program_fit, rationale, notes (optional).`;

return { prompt };
